title: Zouki Daigaku
synopsis:
Graduation work of Moe Iida at Tama Art University.

The short film was officially released online as part of the "TamaGra Animation 2012" screening compilation, celebrating the works of the university's Graphic Design department graduates. Director Moe Iida handles the direction, animation style, and illustration design. The project has also inspired standalone physical primitive art and enamel sculpture galleries by the creator in later exhibitions throughout Tokyo and New York.
